name: Kanzaki Tsubame-4, Hoshikawa Security cruiser
coords: glTF: +Y up, the car faces +Z, +X is the car's left side
origin: ground level under the centre of the body

materials.CarBody: Pigment_car_body (security): one material for the whole body; glass, lenses and the light bar are see-through via base-colour alpha (alphaMode BLEND). In Godot use transparency = Alpha Depth Pre-Pass (or Alpha Hash) on this material so the opaque paint sorts correctly.
materials.CarWheel: Pigment_car_wheel: tyre, rim, disc and caliper

notes: Calipers are separate nodes (Caliper_XX, same origin as Wheel_XX): steer them with the wheel but don't spin them.
Collider is a convex hull (extras: collider=convex, hidden=true): use it as a ConvexPolygonShape3D and hide the mesh.
Headlight_* / Taillight_* empties: put a SpotLight3D / OmniLight3D there; their local -Z is the beam direction.
Metallic flake is not in glTF; the clearcoat is (KHR_materials_clearcoat).
This is the legacy single-livery export; assets/vehicles/tsubame/ has the same car with all its variants and LOD2.
